Rework lris and camellia image publishing (#34)

## Summary
- replace the dedicated `spectra` runtime image with a shared `lris` image backed by a tiny Rust wrapper binary
- split the dyn-workflows into a Rust artifact build, a `lris` image publish job, and a separate `camellia` image publish job
- add a dedicated `camellia` Dockerfile while keeping `labelix_spectra` deploy references pointed at the new `lris` image tags

## Validation
- `cd /code/symphony/0xfe10/workspaces/DAM-39/labelix/lris && cargo check --workspace`
- `cd /code/symphony/0xfe10/workspaces/DAM-39/labelix/bougainvillea && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`
- `cd /code/symphony/0xfe10/workspaces/DAM-39/labelix/bougainvillea && pnpm run check:camellia`
- `cd /code/symphony/0xfe10/workspaces/DAM-39/labelix && docker build -f bougainvillea/apps/camellia/Dockerfile bougainvillea`
- `cd /code/symphony/0xfe10/workspaces/DAM-39/labelix/lris && docker build -f Dockerfile .`

## Notes
- `camellia` is still configured as an SSR React Router app, so the image keeps a Node runtime instead of switching to static hosting.
- The local `lris` Docker build was verified with temporary placeholder binaries after the workspace volume filled during a full local binary build; the workflow now builds the real musl binaries in a dedicated artifact job before assembling the published image.
